notes.title: Ending Dialogue Bug Fixed
notes.notes:
I had reports that the game would freeze on the ending dialogue. I looked through the code and found the culprit!

[i]~As Shar rubs her fingers through Lilith's fat, she turns towards Delilah with a grin, "Now it's your turn."[/i]

notes.title: Bugs Fixed
notes.notes:
[b]To create a smoother experience, I fixed the following bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] When fading between scenes, buttons are disabled to prevent the game from glitching.
[*] The shop visuals are correctly fixed before it shows up, instead of after.
[/list]
Hope you are enjoying the game! 🍗
